description.value: This Walmart Supercenter on Hillside Drive in Kamloops is one of the largest one-stop retail destinations in the region, carrying a full grocery section alongside electronics, clothing, furniture, and baby products. For touring cyclists passing through Kamloops, it offers a broad resupply opportunity — from food and camping consumables to clothing and electronics — under one roof. The store provides free in-store WiFi according to OSM tags.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website front page confirms this is a Walmart Supercenter (Store 3040) in Kamloops, with 'grocery, Electronics, Toys, Clothing, Furniture, Baby' listed as departments, supporting Basic groceries as true. Most subpages returned bot-detection walls, so detailed amenity information (washrooms, bike parking, etc.) could not be confirmed from the website. OSM tags confirm free WiFi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) but this reflects internet access, not device charging, so device charging remains null.
concerns: Most website subpages returned bot-detection challenges ('Verify Your Identity'), preventing confirmation of amenity details such as washrooms, bike parking, and water refill. Only the front-page title yielded usable content.
Phone number and address could not be cross-checked against website content due to bot-blocking; contact_confirmed fields left null or website-only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Walmart Supercenter in Kamloops with confirmed grocery offerings — a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists.
